column1: # Suggested sorting of the open 2.8.0 milestone issues and open pull requests, for the page milestone.html.
# number <tab> group <tab> note.   Groups: review, todo, decide, release, close; pr for a pull request.
# The groups are a suggestion to be confirmed at the meeting, not a decision.

column3: Inside Bounded: any distribution of the same kind plus Offset, no Bounded; inside Offset: no wrapper. Also fixes Normal missing from the list inside Bounded. Walter's review (12 Nov) found two problems: the inputs inside Offset inside Bounded were not shown, and Uniform-type priors were offered inside Bounded (bounds shown twice). Both fixed in #274, checked in the Priors panel; awaiting his re-review.
After #274: BEAUti builds its own "outside the range" message, so a simplex with a wrong sum is still reported as out of range there. Use `whyNotValid()` from #254. Small; beast-fx only.

Strong typing is the point of 2.8.0, and the check is dead code today. Must accept a sub-domain (Walter). This runs when the XML is loaded, not in the MCMC loop. Risk: it will reject XMLs and package templates that load today.
Marked "Target: 2.8.0" in the issue. Changes the RLC and EBSP templates and `BitFlipOperator`, so it needs a posterior comparison before and after.

Bundled: bModelTest, ORC, SA, StarBeast3, CCD. Done and merged: seeding (#276), pinned list and bundle scripts (#278), release order (#277); package manager checked. **Decide:** who builds the packages against rc3; MM for SA's brachiopods example.
The rate input of Gamma is still named `lambda`. Renaming changes XML, so it is now or not at all. **Decide:** rename to `beta` (keeping `lambda` as an alias?) or close.
The XMLs now say `version="2.8"`. **Decide:** is that the answer (close), or does the parser also have to reject older declarations?
The code runs on every `set()` of a parameter, so the change needs a timing check. Adds an interface, breaks nothing. **Decide:** 2.8.0 or 2.9.0 with #252.
One of 12 EBSP runs got stuck at a very high coalescent density. Not investigated further. **Decide:** blocker, known issue in the release notes, or 2.9.0.
Decided 12 Nov: **Alexei** prototypes the single Eclipse project (core + the five bundled packages); **Remco** tests it when back, around 26 Nov.
A large feature (upgrade of Maven packages, per-package upgrade, BEAUti button). **Decide:** which part, if any, is needed for 2.8.0.
CI builds the Linux and Windows bundles (`release-bundles.yml`), but **nobody has tested them**: all testers use Macs. **Decide:** who tests Linux and Windows, and what.
A walk through the package skeleton from clone to installed package. No code expected.
End-to-end test that AppLauncher finds an app of a Maven-installed package.
A manual check of one BEAUti menu. Ten minutes.
Umbrella for the validation; the results are on the other pages of this site. Close at sign-off.
Umbrella for release commits. Close at release.

beast-fx only (#232). Also reports a prior whose support reaches outside the parameter's domain (e.g. Normal bounded to [-1, 1] on a positive parameter). Reviewed by Walter on 12 Nov; both problems fixed (5dc7ed7). Awaiting his re-review.
